rows.Description: Each class has access to at least one armor type. The different armors perform differently in terms of protection from and defense against enemy damage. Some classes have access to many different types of armor.

rows.Name: Guard %n
rows.Description: To Guard is to assign oneself to protect another character and block incoming enemy blows to that person.

rows.Name: Quickcast
rows.Description: Allows spell caster to cast a single spell at twice the power cost to make it so that it cannot be interrupted by melee or spells. The only exception to this is the Necromancer form of Quickcast (Facilitate Painworking). It allows the Necromancer's summoned undead pet to have six seconds of uninterrupted casting time.

rows.Name: Protect
rows.Description: An ability useable on a member of your group. This allows you to reduce some aggression generated by that player.

rows.Name: Weaponry: Scythe
rows.Description: The ability to use scythes of all kinds. Training in the Scythes Skill results in a decreased damage variance and gives you access to the scythe combat styles. This skill is unique to Valewalkers.

rows.Name: 0|Shield Ability: none;1|Shield Ability: Small Shields;2|Shield Ability: Medium Shields;3|Shield Ability: Large Shields
rows.Description: An independent line of defense, which can be raised through training to gain special shield attacks.  The larger the shield, the more protection it provides

rows.Name: Evade %n Ability
rows.Description: The percent chance to dodge enemy swings. If the character?s class has access to the increased versions of this ability, it will progress naturally as they level.  Evasion is a frontal-arc ability and only works against attacks that are coming from the front.

rows.Name: Intercept
rows.Description: Provides a player with the ability to "take one for the team." With this skill, the player may choose one person to Intercept and take the damage, without armor considerations, that would have hit the protected player.  The target must be within melee range.
